name: Indigo Networks
summary: Perth ISP; took over Omon's business c.2001, then acquired by Ace Online 2002.

events.details: WA internet provider, operational by Oct 1996.

refs.label: Earliest capture of the Perth ISP domain.

events.details: ABR name search finds no WA company matching the 1996-2002 Perth ISP: INDIGO NETWORKS PTY LTD (ACN 701 127 666, VIC) has ABN active only from 6 Aug 2026; INDIGO NETWORKS INTERNATIONAL PTY LTD (ACN 108 787 668, WA) dates only from ~2004 with ABN cancelled 3 Jun 2014. Both are later same-name companies, unrelated. A WA sole trader has used 'Indigo Networks' as a trading name since 2 Nov 2005 (ABN 73 420 393 074) — possible brand continuation after the Ace Online acquisition, unverified.

refs.label: ABR: INDIGO NETWORKS PTY LTD ACN 701 127 666 (unrelated 2026 VIC company, not the Perth ISP)
